user.title: Atomberg
user.description: Add the integration to listen for local Atomberg fan state broadcasts. Devices are added when they announce themselves.

init.title: Light intensity mapping
init.description: Optional: enter the fan-reported protocol brightness values captured for Low and High. Leave both blank to keep the discrete slider hidden. Do not infer the values from the LED power bit.

error.invalid_light_stage_values: Enter both distinct protocol brightness values, each from 1 to 100, or leave both blank.
